cards.card_text: The names go on in the order the sons were born, engraved the way a gem cutter engraves a seal, then set in gold filigree.
cards.verse_text: Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
cards.snippet: Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.

cards.card_text: Then come gold filigree settings and two chains of pure gold, braided like cord and attached to the settings.
cards.verse_text: Fashion gold filigree settings and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.
cards.snippet: Fashion gold filigree settings and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work;…

cards.card_text: Next, onyx stones go into gold filigree settings.
cards.verse_text: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
cards.snippet: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of…

cards.card_text: Twelve stones, all set in gold filigree, and friend, I can't even get sprinkles to sit in a straight line.
cards.verse_text: These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
cards.snippet: These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
